blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Promotes cooperative federalism by ensuring the active participation of states.
Fosters competitive federalism among states to encourage development.
Formulates strategic and long-term policy frameworks.
Encourages innovation and entrepreneurship across the country.
Supports sustainable and inclusive growth as core developmental goals.
NITI Aayog uniquely balances both Cooperative Federalism (active state participation) and Competitive Federalism.
Formulating strategic and long-term policy frameworks is a primary objective frequently asked in exams.
Innovation, entrepreneurship, and sustainable/inclusive development form the core mandates of NITI Aayog.
